project.name: Nanashi installation website
project.productType: Native app installation and release hub

must: Preserve Nanashi Cold Glass identity and upstream attribution
No health data or analytics on website
Minimum 44px control targets; keyboard and reduced motion support
Only published and validated artifacts can become download links
21st-derived visual patterns with visible exact source links

decisions.decision: Use static CSS adaptations of three retrieved 21st components, sharing the native app palette. No motion library required.
decisions.reason: Retain cold-glass character with small runtime and stable keyboard interactions.

decisions.decision: Prioritize a direct SideStore install link for returning iPhone users; separate one-time setup from updates. Detect the phone platform with a manual override, keep technical options collapsed, and hand desktop visitors to a QR plus a copyable link.
decisions.reason: The user found installation too complicated. Reuse the existing 21st-derived glass surfaces and controls without an onboarding library or claims that the browser can detect installation success.
decisions.grounding: Reviewed search results Minimal Welcome Onboarding 29517, Onboarding Checklist 5587 and Onboarding Steps with Progress 29458. No code was retrieved or incorporated from these results; the installed GlassPanel, GlassLink and PlatformTabs primitives remain the component sources.

decisions.decision: Keep first-time SideStore setup on a dedicated French Nanashi page with six revisitable steps, direct official downloads and browser-local progress.
decisions.reason: The user rejects external documentation handoffs; preserve existing 21st-derived glass primitives and make each action explicit without claiming native installation detection.
